docs.summary: What every open shader editor shares: how includes resolve, the indexes of included files, and the compiler used for diagnostics. Names starting with Graphite/ come from [`ShaderLibrary`](#api~Prowl.Graphite.ShaderDef.ShaderLibrary), everything else from the host.

members.signature: public ShaderWorkspace(Func<string, string?, ShaderSource?>? resolveInclude = null, Func<string?, IEnumerable<string>>? includeNames = null)

params.resolveInclude: Resolves an include name seen in a file to its source, or null. Graphite/ names never reach it.
params.includeNames: Include names offered while typing #include in a file, besides the Graphite library.

docs.summary: Turns a shader with a Surface block into the passes the renderer would build, so they can be compiled for diagnostics. Without it those shaders are only checked for wrapper errors.
Defines set for every compile, such as the engine's own.
